logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, uriParam: if (!isEmpty(attributes.uriParams)) attributes.uriParams[0] else null, message: "Initiating customer " ++ attributes.method ++ " request to database" }]

#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: vars.saveMethod, details:{ message: "Customer successfully delete into database.", "affected_rows": payload.affectedRows default 1 } }]
